```yaml
name: Update ingestr

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # run daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-ingestr:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Check for ingestr update
        id: check
        run: |
          echo "Checking for ingestr updates..."
          UPDATE_LINE=$(go list -m -u all | grep '^github.com/ingestr/ingestr ' || true)
          if [ -n "$UPDATE_LINE" ]; then
            echo "has_update=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "update_line=$UPDATE_LINE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "has_update=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Update ingestr
        if: steps.check.outputs.has_update == 'true'
        run: |
          MODULE=$(echo "${{ steps.check.outputs.update_line }}" | awk '{print $1}')
          echo "Updating $MODULE to latest version..."
          go get -u "$MODULE"
          go mod tidy

      - name: Commit changes
        if: steps.check.outputs.has_update == 'true'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add go.mod go.sum
          git commit -m "chore: bump ingestr to latest version" || echo "No changes to commit"

      - name: Push changes
        if: steps.check.outputs.has_update == 'true'
        run: |
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/update-ingestr

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.check.outputs.has_update == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: update-ingestr
          base: main
          title: "chore: bump ingestr to latest version"
          body: |
            Automated update of ingestr to the latest available version.
          delete-branch: true
```
